verdict.rationale: Gusto exposes webhook events (e.g., payroll.paid) that let a developer's application 'perform subsequent business logic' when an event occurs, which is a form of event-triggered automation, but this requires writing custom integration code rather than letting a user simply 'define rules' via a no-code rules engine. Missing for 10: a native rule-builder/no-code automation UI, conditional trigger-action configuration, and evidence of end-user (non-developer) rule definition rather than developer-only webhook subscriptions.
